_meta.purpose: Pre-registered hypothesis queue for the ALPHA_RANKER model-improvement loop. Each item is registered BEFORE results exist (RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md §0). Status: queued|running|done. Verdict filled by card. Children spawned by the prioritizer.
_meta.kill_default: OOS IC_IR < 0.20 OR lag_test_delta > 25% OR PBO > 0.5 OR fails placebo

hypotheses.name: 65DMA vs 50DMA
hypotheses.construct: dist_from_65DMA and 65DMA-slope vs the 50DMA equivalents; also 65>150>200 stack vs 50>150>200

hypotheses.name: MA-period sweep
hypotheses.construct: dist & slope for DMA in {20,30,40,50,55,60,65,75,100,120,150,200}; find robust plateau, not a single lucky length

hypotheses.name: 12-1 residual momentum
hypotheses.construct: 12m return skip last 1m, on RESIDUAL return (FF-neutralized)

hypotheses.name: vol-scaled momentum
hypotheses.construct: trailing return / realized vol (Sharpe-momentum) at 3/6/12m

hypotheses.name: raw vs residual momentum
hypotheses.construct: compare raw 12-1 vs residual 12-1 incremental IR — is momentum just beta?

hypotheses.name: 52w-high proximity (O'Neil)
hypotheses.construct: close / 252d-high; and new-52w-high flag

hypotheses.name: RS-line new high (O'Neil)
hypotheses.construct: stock/NIFTY ratio making new 6m high while price bases

hypotheses.name: VCP / volatility contraction (Minervini)
hypotheses.construct: declining ATR% + volume dry-up within an uptrend (price>200DMA)

hypotheses.name: Weinstein stage-2
hypotheses.construct: price>30wk MA & 30wk MA rising & RS positive → stage-2 flag

hypotheses.name: low-vol anomaly
hypotheses.construct: trailing 252d realized vol, inverse; also idiosyncratic vol

hypotheses.name: idiosyncratic vol (residual)
hypotheses.construct: std of FF-regression residuals, 63/252d

hypotheses.name: downside beta / semideviation
hypotheses.construct: beta to down-market days; downside deviation

hypotheses.name: vol term-structure
hypotheses.construct: ratio short-vol(21d)/long-vol(252d) — vol expansion vs contraction

hypotheses.name: earnings yield
hypotheses.construct: TTM EPS / price (inverse P/E); PIT

hypotheses.name: FCF yield

hypotheses.name: EV/EBITDA vs own history

hypotheses.name: reverse-DCF implied growth gap

hypotheses.name: Greenblatt magic formula

hypotheses.name: ROIC level & stability

hypotheses.name: Piotroski F-score

hypotheses.name: gross profitability (Novy-Marx)

hypotheses.name: accruals (Sloan)

hypotheses.name: earnings stability & margin trend

hypotheses.name: sales/EPS CAGR 3y & 5y

hypotheses.name: growth acceleration

hypotheses.name: earnings surprise / PEAD
hypotheses.construct: actual vs own-trend expectation; post-earnings drift window

hypotheses.name: O'Neil CANSLIM composite
hypotheses.construct: C(qtr EPS accel)+A(annual EPS)+N(new high/product)+S(vol/float)+L(RS leader)+I(instituional)+M(mkt regime) proxies

hypotheses.name: size / marketcap tilt

hypotheses.name: quality x momentum
hypotheses.construct: double-sort / product of quality and residual momentum ranks

hypotheses.name: value x quality (QARP)

hypotheses.name: factor x regime conditioning
hypotheses.construct: factor efficacy split by regime_timeline (bull/bear/vol/leadership) → regime-conditional weights

hypotheses.name: raw vs market-excess vs residual scoring
hypotheses.construct: re-score current model on each return basis; measure how much of score is closet-beta

hypotheses.name: mean-reversion short-term

hypotheses.name: weight-learning vs equal/prior

hypotheses.kill: learned weights don't beat prior OOS after deflation

hypotheses.name: sector-momentum tilt (own macro-sector RS as stock factor)
hypotheses.construct: own_sector_rs_factor(panel, level='macro_sector', lookback=252, skip=21) = (sector composite mom - NIFTY mom), broadcast to every stock in that sector; closes FRAMEWORK_CATALOG.md's flagged HIGH-PRIORITY GAP #1 (sector-momentum tilt).
hypotheses.rationale: KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md #11 / MULTIBAGGER_DNA.md: every era's giant winners cluster in one hot sector.

hypotheses.name: within-sub-sector residual momentum (peer-relative) vs plain
hypotheses.construct: PLAIN=build_mom_resid_12_1(panel) (builders_mom.py H003); PEER=peer_relative(PLAIN, level='sub_sector', method='z') -- z-score demeaned within sub_sector at each date. Tests whether sector-neutralizing residual momentum adds edge over the raw factor.
hypotheses.rationale: FRAMEWORK_CATALOG.md #1 'Residual/idiosyncratic momentum' + 'Relative strength vs sector' rows.

hypotheses.name: within-sub-sector earnings yield (peer-relative) vs plain
hypotheses.construct: PLAIN=build_H014_earnings_yield(panel) (builders_value.py); PEER=peer_relative(PLAIN, level='sub_sector', method='z'). Tests whether sector-relative value beats absolute value cross-sectionally.
hypotheses.rationale: FRAMEWORK_CATALOG.md #2 'Valuation vs own history percentile + vs sector peers'.
